Security and data-exposure policy

Source: .github/SECURITY.md

Reporting a security problem

sysPrep is an offline R package: it does not open network connections, store credentials, or run a service. If you believe you have found a vulnerability (for example, code that could execute untrusted input), please report it privately through GitHub’s “Report a vulnerability” button on the Security tab, or email the maintainer at the address in the DESCRIPTION file. Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability.

Accidentally posted sensitive data

sysPrep processes syndromic surveillance records, which can be sensitive. If patient-level data, identifiable facility information, or anything covered by a data use agreement has been posted in an issue, pull request, or comment (including in a screenshot or copied console output), please contact the maintainer immediately by the same private routes so it can be removed. Do not wait for a reply before editing or deleting your own post.

Please reproduce problems with the package’s synthetic datasets instead; see CONTRIBUTING.md.

Supported versions

Fixes are made to the current release only.
